name: scope-detector-semantic-v1
declared: 2026-10-08, before any embedding was computed for this experiment
purpose: Replace the word-overlap test for 'the question identifies this subtype' (rejected in scope-detector-v3-nearmiss) with a semantic one using the project's local Nomic embeddings. Free; runs on Sebastian's machine with LM Studio. No generation, no paid call, no holdout.

rule.candidates: all distinct subtype titles (headings index 3) under the Chapter 2 families of the section-hierarchy guide, parent mastercard-chargeback-guide, with parenthetical text removed
rule.similarity: cosine between the question embedded as a query and each title embedded as a document, same prefixes as retrieval
rule.established: the cited passage's subtype is the single closest title to the question AND its cosine is at least tau AND it exceeds the second-closest title by at least delta. If established, family codes inherited by the passage are not flagged; phrase qualifiers (participating countries, stand-in, x-code, required authorization) are unaffected

calibration.selection: among grid points that flag all 12 unscoped rows, take the one with the fewest scoped false flags; ties by larger tau, then larger delta; if none flags all 12, take the most unscoped flagged, then fewest scoped false flags. Chosen once, written to a file with its hash, before the test set is touched

test.use: read once after calibration; the runner refuses a second test run

thresholds.S1: On the near-miss test set the chosen detector clears (fails to flag) at most 3 of 12 rows
thresholds.S2: On the calibration set the chosen detector flags at least 11 of 12 unscoped rows and falsely flags at most 4 of 12 scoped rows (v2 falsely flags 7)
thresholds.S3: Development regression: on the 40 valid development answers it flags exactly the cited passages v2 flags (E13 and E22 only)
thresholds.S4: Unit tests for the decision rule and the grid selection pass

reported_not_thresholded: per-row nearest title, cosine and margin
E16 under the chosen detector (known case, designed after seeing it)
decision_rule: Pass only if S1 to S4 hold. A pass makes it the candidate detector for a fresh end-to-end Mastercard evaluation. A fail leaves v2 as the default and the finding stands: neither string overlap nor embeddings separate 'described' from 'merely related' on these labels.
limits: Labels are mine; calibration and test sets are small (24 and 12 rows) and the test set was written to attack the word-overlap rule
Only Mastercard Chapter 2 subtype titles are candidates
Margin and threshold are fitted to 24 rows: expect optimism
Embedding similarity to a short title is a noisy proxy for 'identifies the subtype'
Needs LM Studio with the Nomic model loaded; embeddings cached by hash
